svg.title: Modern control families on a 104-key ANSI keyboard
svg.desc: Standard 15-unit ANSI main keyboard, including unbound keys and modifiers. Navigation, arrow and numpad clusters are shown below, not in their physical position to the right of the main keyboard. Enter opens all actions, inventory groups equipment and crafting, Space groups tile actions. Shift-direction selects freely; Ctrl-direction physically peeks with the normal cost. Classic controls are unchanged.
svg.text: ANSI layout · action below each key · ⇧ means Shift · direction modifiers are grouped in the legend
Separate clusters — shown below for readable labels
Shift + (unbound) (unbound) (unbound) (unbound) (unbound) (unbound) (unbound) (unbound): free tile selection; starts at you, accumulates.
Ctrl + W A S D Q E Z C: physical peek (200 moves); cancel returns.
Arrows: free aim reticle. Tab / Shift+Tab: next / previous hostile.
f attacks selection; guns use normal aim. Bump attacks still work.
Modern curses: Ctrl+C/Z are game chords, not quit/suspend signals.
Enter: all action groups; Info → character sheet and body/status screens.
v: wield. i: inventory → item actions; inventory F5: Craft, even when empty.
@: character; P: messages; B: butcher; F: fire mode; /: advanced inventory.
Space: selected tile actions, or a flat nearby list with directions and a target highlight.
RMB selects; Select tile keys are unbound by default; Jump and Smash require an explicit choice.
Map RMB selects freely; LMB uses adjacent doors/items/furniture or attacks; never walks.
g opens pickup; g confirms. Inventory/pickup: wheel scrolls; RMB opens item actions.
Blank keycaps have no default map action. Local menu keys and Classic controls are unchanged.
Classic terminal Ctrl+C/Z retain normal quit/suspend signal behavior.
